DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みの金額は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided how much to transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 頼まれた額はありますが、私が立て替えた分も足すか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 依頼額への立替分追加を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is an amount I was asked to send, but I am unsure whether to add what I paid in advance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss adding the amount you paid in advance to the requested amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 金額の合意は相手とご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please confirm the agreed amount with the other person.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ相談していません。窓口で相手の代わりに決めてもらうこともできませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 金額合意未確認と窓口の役割を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not discussed it yet. You cannot decide on the other person's behalf at the counter either, can you?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not confirmed agreement on the amount and understand the counter's role. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お客様同士の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to confirm it between yourselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、立替分を別にメモして、合計してよいか友人へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 立替額を別記して相手へ照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will note the amount I paid in advance separately and ask my friend whether I may add it to the total.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Record the advance payment separately and ask the other person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認前に実行しないということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: So you will not make the transfer before confirming?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。返事を待ちます。依頼額と立替額を二行に分けて送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二額を分けて回答まで実行保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: That's right. I will wait for a reply. I will send the requested amount and the advance payment on two separate lines.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the two amounts and hold off on the transfer until you receive a reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 振込先の情報も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also confirm the recipient's account details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。金額の返事だけでなく、送る口座も合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金額と振込先を両方確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will confirm both the amount in the reply and the account to send it to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm both the amount and the recipient's account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 合意した金額と振込先が決まったら、お手続きをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once the agreed amount and destination account are settled, I will explain the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会計した鞄にタグが残っています。自分で外してよいか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計後防犯タグの残存を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The security tag is still on the bag I paid for. I was unsure whether I should remove it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a security tag left on a purchase after payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで確認します。レシートはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check it here. Do you have your receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。鞄を買った記録はこれです。タグは引っ張っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシート提示と未牽引を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Here is the record of my bag purchase. I have not pulled on the tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and explain that you have not pulled the tag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入品とレシートを照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will compare the purchased item with the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。出口で気づきましたが、そのまま帰らず戻りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 退出せず売場へ戻った経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I noticed it at the exit, but I came back instead of going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you returned to the sales area instead of leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認が取れたら、担当が外します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once we confirm it, the person responsible will remove it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。はさみで切る方法を教えてほしいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己切断でなく担当対応を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I am not asking you to tell me how to cut it off with scissors.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for staff assistance rather than cutting it off yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの購入品にも残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are there tags left on any other purchases?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この一つだけです。ほかの品は袋のまま、私が持って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象一品と他品本人保管を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only this one. I will hold the other items in their bags while I wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify the one affected item and that you will keep the others with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この鞄を担当が確認します。タグには触れず、取り外しが済むまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The person responsible will check this bag. Please do not touch the tag and wait until it has been removed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名前のような言葉が聞こえました。散歩している人への呼出しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拡声器音が一般客の呼出しか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard something that sounded like a name. Is it an announcement calling someone who is out walking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the loudspeaker sound is calling a visitor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行事準備のマイク確認です。個人の呼出しではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is a microphone check for event preparations. It is not calling an individual.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうなのですね。私が近くへ行って返事をする必要はないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個人の応答不要を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. So I do not need to go over there and respond?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that no individual response is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。準備区域の外をお通りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. Please walk outside the preparation area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。音が苦手な家族がいるので、少し離れた道へ回りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 音に弱い家族のため遠い道を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. A member of my family is sensitive to noise, so I would like to take a path a little farther away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a more distant path for a family member who is sensitive to sound. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内図で別の園路を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check another park path on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見せてください。出口へ戻るのではなく、散歩を続けられる道がよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅でなく継続散歩の経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please show me. I would prefer a path where we can continue our walk, rather than return to the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a route to continue walking rather than go home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの園路を通れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can take this park path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家族に試験の音だと伝えてから、この道へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族へ音の意味を伝えて迂回する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will tell my family that it is a test sound, then take this path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the sound to your family and take the detour. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備区域を避けてお進みください。ご家族と無理のない場所で散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please avoid the preparation area. Enjoy your walk with your family somewhere comfortable for everyone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図をお持ちですね。どちらへ行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a map. Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この施設です。ただ、地図が古くて、自分で引いた矢印もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 古い地図と私的な矢印を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This facility. But the map is old, and it also has arrows I drew myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the old map and your own arrows. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 矢印はいつ書きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: When did you draw the arrows?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 数年前です。今も通れると思って歩き始めないほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 過去の道順を流用しないと判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Several years ago. I should not start walking on the assumption that the route is still accessible, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide not to reuse old directions without checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の案内を担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's ask the person responsible for current directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 目的地の名前も変わっていないか、一緒に聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的地の名称も確認するよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please also ask whether the destination's name has changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to check the destination's name too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 問い合わせる間、地図を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: May I see the map while I ask?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。印は私の書き込みで、公式の道順ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書き込みの出所を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Of course. The markings are my own additions, not official directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the source of the handwritten markings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できた道順だけ、新しい紙へ書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後に新しい道順を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will copy only the confirmed directions onto a new sheet of paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write down the new directions after confirming them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、目的地と道順を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check the destination and route before giving you directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この図についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss this drawing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。部屋に番号を付けましたが、何の部屋か書いていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部屋番号の説明不足を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I numbered the rooms, but I forgot to write what each room is used for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the room numbers lack descriptions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 寝室です。二番は台所で、相談したいのはその間の通路です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 部屋の用途と相談箇所を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bedroom. Number two is the kitchen, and I want to discuss the passage between them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the rooms' uses and the area you want to discuss. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図の縮尺は正確ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is the drawing accurately to scale?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。配置を示すために手で描いたもので、実寸ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 縮尺が実寸ではないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I drew it by hand to show the layout; it does not show actual dimensions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that the drawing is not to actual scale. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な寸法は担当と確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the required measurements with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の図には「配置のみ」と書いて、測った数字は別の紙にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配置図と実測値を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will label this drawing "layout only" and put the measured figures on a separate sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the layout drawing from the measured dimensions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どのような点を相談したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: What would you like advice about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通路に置く物を減らしたいので、配置の考え方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配置相談の目的を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I want to reduce the number of things in the passage, so I would like advice on how to arrange them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the purpose of your layout consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 図の番号と縮尺の説明を付けて担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the person responsible, including explanations of the drawing's numbers and scale.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 症状の写真をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have photographs of the symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも、画面の順番が撮った日とは違っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真一覧の並び方の問題を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but the order on the screen is different from the order of the dates they were taken.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the problem with the order of the photo list. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の症状はどの写真ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which photos show the current symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この三枚です。一枚だけ、以前の別の傷が混じっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回の写真と別の傷を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: These three. One photo of a different, earlier injury is mixed in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the current photos from the other injury. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の傷は分けてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分けました。三枚には撮った日をメモで添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影日を付けて整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have separated it. I will attach notes with the dates these three photos were taken.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Organize the photos with their shooting dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影時の明るさは同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Was the lighting the same when you took them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 違います。色が変わったように見えても、光の違いもあると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 光条件による色の差を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. Even if the color appears to have changed, I think differences in lighting are also a factor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain color differences caused by lighting conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その条件も診察で説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain those conditions during the consultation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日付順に見せて、明るさが違うことも伝えます。写真だけで判断はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時系列と条件を診察へ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show them in date order and mention the different lighting. I will not judge from the photos alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present the chronology and conditions during the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その三枚と条件を担当へお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please show those three photos and explain the conditions to the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ほかに事情を知る方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Does anyone else know what happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人が現場を見ていました。ただ、私から話の内容を代わりに説明することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人の目撃と本人からの説明が必要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An acquaintance saw the scene. But I cannot give their account on their behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that an acquaintance witnessed it and needs to give their own account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その方にお話を伺えると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: It would help if we could speak with that person.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人の同意なく電話番号を渡さず、先に連絡してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号を渡す前の同意確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: May I contact them first, rather than give you their phone number without their consent?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to obtain consent before sharing the phone number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ご本人から連絡してもらう方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. They can also contact us themselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その場合の窓口と、伝えておく情報を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人連絡の窓口と情報を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: In that case, please tell me which contact point to use and what information I should pass along.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the contact point and information needed for direct contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この相談の受付内容を示していただければ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check if they show the intake details for this consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付の控えを見て、相談した日と窓口を知人へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えに基づき案内を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look at the receipt for this consultation and tell my acquaintance the date and contact point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Share the guidance based on the intake receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 知人が実際に見たことは、ご本人から伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask your acquaintance directly about what they actually saw.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。返事を急がせず、本人に連絡する意思を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 知人の連絡意思を確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will ask whether they want to contact you, without rushing their reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to ask whether your acquaintance wishes to make contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの案内を渡し、ご本人のご連絡をお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please give them this information, and we will wait for them to contact us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封をした箱をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending this sealed box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その前に、部品の使い方を書いた手紙を入れ忘れたことに気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明書きの同封忘れを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before that, I realized I forgot to enclose a letter explaining how to use the parts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you forgot to enclose the instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外から添えるだけではなく、同封したいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You want it inside, rather than simply attached to the outside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。箱を開け直して、受取人が最初に見る位置へ入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手紙を最初に見える位置へ入れたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I want to reopen the box and place it where the recipient will see it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to put the letter where it will be seen first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身が動かないように整えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Arrange the contents so they do not move around.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 部品の包みはそのままにして、手紙だけ上へ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部品を動かさず手紙を配置する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will leave the wrapped parts as they are and put only the letter on top.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Position the letter without moving the parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手紙に必要な説明は書けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does the letter include all the necessary explanations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つの部品の名前と組み合わせ方を書きました。自分の連絡先も添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明の内容と連絡先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote the names of the two parts and how to put them together. I will add my contact details too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the explanation's contents and contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 整ってから、改めて封をしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once everything is arranged, please seal it again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手紙を入れて閉じました。入れ直した状態で重さを量ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再封後の箱の計量を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have put the letter inside and closed it. Please weigh it with the letter now enclosed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to have the resealed box weighed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、説明を同封した箱として確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check the box with the instructions enclosed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記帳された内容についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the entries in your passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ日の二行を、家計簿で一件として書いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 合算した家計記録の問題を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I recorded two lines from the same date as one item in my household ledger.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the problem with the combined household record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are the amounts the same too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違います。合計すると家計簿の数字になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二行の金額関係を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. Their total matches the figure in my household ledger.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the relationship between the amounts on the two lines. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、二行は別の記載として見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, please treat the two lines as separate entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それぞれの表示を読みたいです。この略語は何を表していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 略語の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to read each description. What does this abbreviation stand for?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what the abbreviation means. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示の説明を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask the person responsible to explain the descriptions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家計簿はすぐ直さず、説明を聞いてから二件に分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明後に家計簿を修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not correct my household ledger immediately; I will divide it into two items after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct the household ledger after the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取引そのものを変更するご希望ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You are not asking to change the transactions themselves, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。記載の意味を確認して、自分の記録を整理したいだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取引変更でなく記録整理と限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Correct. I only want to check what the entries mean and organize my own records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Make clear that you want to organize records, not change transactions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、二行の表示について確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check the descriptions on the two lines.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この袋を二つでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like two of these bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: レシピを倍にするつもりですが、一袋が何グラムか見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 分量と袋数の取り違えを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to double the recipe, but I overlooked how many grams are in one bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your mix-up between quantities and numbers of bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらに内容量があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The net weight is shown here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一袋二百グラムですね。必要なのは三百グラムでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一袋の量と必要量を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One bag is 200 grams, then. I needed 300 grams.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Compare the quantity in one bag with the amount needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二袋なら百グラム余ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: With two bags, you will have 100 grams left over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 余りは別の料理に使います。小袋よりこちらを二袋にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 余りの用途を決めて袋数を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use the remainder in another dish. I will take two of these rather than the smaller bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide how to use the remainder and choose the number of bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの材料も人数を変えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you adjusted the servings for the other ingredients too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。肉と野菜も、袋数ではなく重さで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他の材料も重さで確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I will check the meat and vegetables by weight too, rather than by number of bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the other ingredients by weight as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 買う前に表示を見てくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the labels before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。必要量を書いたメモと照らしてから会計へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモとの照合後に会計すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will compare them with my note of the quantities needed before going to the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to go to checkout after comparing with your note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、表示で分からない点があればお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please ask if anything on the labels is unclear.
